# Set-Aside Brief

> Small business set-aside contracts open now, searchable by deadline, set-aside type, NAICS code and state. Free, updated daily from SAM.gov data.

Guides are researched from official sources, cite them, and are reviewed regularly.

## Guides
- [Total vs Partial Small Business Set Aside: 2026 Checklist](https://setasidebrief.com/total-vs-partial-small-business-set-aside-2026-checklist/): Total vs partial small business set aside explained: FAR rule of two, 50% subcontracting limits, HUBZone price rules, and a step-by-step bid checklist.
- [Capability Statement Example: 5 Sections Buyers Read First](https://setasidebrief.com/capability-statement-example-5-sections-buyers-read-first/): A capability statement example broken into the 5 sections contracting officers check first, with SBA and SAM.gov steps, a sample layout and common fixes.
